name: Hanemiya Tsukasa
source:
She has been working as a private detective since she was a student.
Despite her young age, she is a capable girl backed up by her excellent insight and has solved many cases.
Her achievements and her pretty appearance have earned her the nickname 'beautiful girl detective'.
However, she is also a very confident person with a strong sense of justice as a detective, and when she she sees a case, she is a headstrong troublemaker.
She was involved in a case when the protagonist was experimenting with his abilities and was molested by his invisible hand,
She is pursuing the protagonist to investigate the paranormal events that happened to her at that time.


Translated from https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1236802&gc=gc
